exclusions.argument: No binary degree exists to realize a nonquiescent instance, interaction relation, or reachable-future variable.
The reference proto-object requires one dynamic event schema plus one separately charged interaction-relation schema. One schema cannot satisfy both typed roles without bundling.
Fresh layer outputs are quiescent unless a registered production row emits an event. With zero laws, layer 1 and every later layer are all zero, so no active dyad can form.

nonclaim: These exclusions do not prove impossibility under an unenumerated alternative primitive, topology, or law grammar.
